entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please say or enter your customer ID number.
Ugh, 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. Agent. Just get me an agent.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return the VeloBand Pulse I ordered. It's just not what I was expecting.
I can certainly look into that for you. I see the order here, delivered 12 days ago. Just to confirm, you're Mr. Evans?
Yes, that's me. And what do you mean 12 days? I just got back into town.
I understand, sir. I'm just looking at the return policy for this specific item. It appears the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window from the date of delivery.

Are you serious? Ten days? That's impossible. Look, this whole thing has been a nightmare. First off, it **was a gift** for my wife. Right after it arrived, we had a family emergency and were **traveling** unexpectedly because her mother ended up in the **hospital**. It was very sudden.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope she's doing better now.

She's recovering, but that's not the point. I tried to start the return on my phone from the waiting room, and your **website crashed** on me three times. I finally get home, and you're telling me I'm two days too late? I don't remember seeing that in the **fine print** anywhere.

I can appreciate your frustration, Mr. Evans, and I do apologize for the trouble with the website. The policy for the Pulse is in place for health and hygiene reasons, and our system automatically locks the return authorization after the 10-day mark. I'm afraid I can't process a standard refund.
Unbelievable. So I'm just out $150 because of your website issues and my family emergency? I'm a VIP member! I've spent thousands here over the years. This is how you treat loyal customers?

I understand completely, and you are absolutely right, you've been one of our most valued customers for a long time. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold. I'd like to consult my support lead to see what options we might have given the circumstances. I want to find a way to make this right for you.
Fine. But this is ridiculous.

Thank you for holding, Mr. Evans. I appreciate your patience. I've discussed the situation, and while a cash refund is outside of policy, I was able to get a special exception approved for you. What I can do is issue a full store credit for the VeloBand Pulse, for $149.99.
A store credit... I guess that's better than nothing.

And on top of that, to apologize for the extreme inconvenience and the trouble you had when our website crashed, I'm adding an additional $25 credit to your account. That gives you a total of $174.99 to use on any future VeloFit gear, with no expiration.
Oh. Wow. The full amount plus extra? That's... actually, that's very helpful. My wife has been looking at one of your new cycling jerseys. This would more than cover it.

I'm so glad we could find a good solution for you. I've just applied that full credit to your account, it should be available for you to use immediately. You can just keep or dispose of the VeloBand as you see fit.
That's fantastic. Thank you, Alex. I really appreciate you going the extra mile on this. I was pretty frustrated.
It's my pleasure, Mr. Evans. We value your business and are happy we could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for being a loyal VeloFit customer, and have a wonderful day.
